Class WeaponFactory

java.lang.Object
main.factory.baseFactories.WeaponFactory
public class WeaponFactory extends Object
Factory class for creating weapon items. Provides methods to create weapons by ID, name, or randomly. Contains 24 predefined weapons with various rarities and properties.
